column3: You idiot, always jumping into danger. Nothing broken?
There's nothing more we can do... Let's get out of here.
Come on, you've gotta value your life more...
Chiricooo, let's talk about running away already...
Oh, and one more thing. Sometimes we can bring you an AT.
Mind you, we'll swipe it from the garage, so it has to be in the garage.
So that's how it is. If you get hit in an AT, bail out fast.
Oops, I forgot this. Listen, Chirico, some things you can't see from an AT.
What are they, you ask? ...Treasure, of course!
Mission Disks and money may be hidden on the battlefield. Like in containers.
You can't pick that stuff up in an AT. Get out and grab it.
It's risky, but the treasure waiting for you more than makes up for it!
Hey, be careful! I can only bail you out like this right now!
There's something I have to do...
Not in a place like this... Fyana...
They're coming from the front... How many?
First I need to steal an AT
This is all I can rely on... But will it work this time?!
If you're going to shoot, then shoot!
The real me was killed by you people back then anyway!
My husband and children were killed! By you and your comrades!
If you're going to do it, do it quick! Killing is your fun, isn't it!
Sorry to keep you waiting, Chirico!
Talk later. Let's get outta here.
As long as I'm with Chirico, I'll fight on and live...
What's wrong, Chirico! Call yourself a soldier?
I'll defeat you, I swear it!
A major victory! My command was flawless!
I'll kill you! I'll kill youuu!
It's crawling with Vilar! Damn it!
I'll take care of the blue AT!
Heh heh! I'll be waiting for you in the next world!
The enemy base is close. Be careful.
Can you still go on? Chirico.
There are still swarms of them!
I'll lend you a hand, too.
I've never... faced anyone like this...
One down on my side too
You're the best... The best prey I've ever had! You hear me?!
I didn't survive this long on luck... It was skill...!
I won't let you die... even if it costs my life...
I won't let you lay a hand on Chirico!
This time I'll finish you off for good!
What are you doing?! Protect the ship!
No good! We're fighting the blue AT over here!
Tch... Enemies all around... What now?
Damn it all... After chasing him this far...
I don't want to die... Not before I put one in him!
Hff... hff... I won't... let you escape...
If you want to see Fyana, you'll have to defeat me...
Only the chosen win... Only I, the Perfect Soldier!
Heh heh heh... This is your grave!
I am a being who has transcended humanity!
There is no victory for you!
No holding back! Clean 'em all up, Chirico!
That's it, keep it up! Chirico, sweetie!
That's a Votoms pilot for ya! Chirico's got guts!
Heh heh... Perfect, let's swipe this AT!
Even Chirico will have trouble against those thugs.
It'd be convenient if they took each other out, wouldn't it?
Fuhahaha... Soon I'll get to see Chirico's end...
Whoa! Did they get Chirico...? Alright...!
Hey, Chirico! A brand-new AT! It's at the map point, go get it!
I got you an AT. Check the map for where it is!
Chirico, I left an AT at the map point! Go get it!
Chirico, I left an AT at the map point! Go get it!
The supply AT should be at the map point by now.
The supply AT should have arrived at the map point...
The supply AT should be at the map point...
There should still be an AT at the map point...
Geez, you sure keep me busy.
Hanging around you, no amount of money or lives would be enough...
You're one lucky guy, you know that!
That's right, that's why we saved you!
I sent an AT to the map point! Use it!
There's an AT at the map point! Chirico!
I've prepared a spare AT at the map point...
Airman 2nd Class Vanilla, reporting for duty!
Chirico, I dropped a brand-new AT at the map point!
Even Chirico can't handle this... Should we run...
Coconna, we don't even know if WE can get away safely...
Let's just get out ourselves, okay?
Hold on, you two! Are you gonna leave Chirico to die?
If we dawdle too, we'll get caught!
Let's get out of this town, fast!
We can't just leave Chirico like this!
What're you gonna do? Don't tell me you're gonna...
Calm down, Coconna. It can't be helped...
I feel for Chirico... but there's nothing we can do!
Leaving a friend to die... you really are losers!
Can't be helped, let's do it!
I love war! I'm ex-Red Shoulder, after all!
Hanging around Chirico, no number of lives would be enough!
That guy's luck is rotten all the way down...
It's all over now... Give up, Coconna
We came to save you, be grateful, huh?
Not afraid to die for the man they love, huh...
Fine! Fine! I'll do it, okay?!
Hey! Are you just gonna sit and watch Chirico get killed?!
What can we do? You want the three of us to take them on?!
No number of lives would be enough!
I'd love to save Chirico, but I'm not obliged to bet my life on it!
Ah, there's too much danger. I can't see this going smoothly...
Come on, let's get outta here fast!
Come on, let's save Chirico! Hurry!
Idiot... Don't even joke about that...
I know how you feel... Coconna, give it up...
With a gun pointed at us, what choice do we have...
Hey! Don't you guys care about Chirico at all?!
He'll be fine. It's him we're talking about...
For once, think about us instead of Chirico...
No waaay! I'll go save Chirico by myself if I have to!
What can you do on your own?!
When she puts it like that, what can we do...
Leaving a friend to die isn't something a human does!
What grudge do you have against Chirico?!
If you don't save Chirico now, I'll never forgive you!
Shall we do this? Eh, Gotho?
Can't be helped. We're all in the same boat, right?
Yeah, good idea! We gotta look cool once in a while too!
The Gilgamesh and Balarant systems waged a war of unclear cause for a century
Near the end of the war, with both sides exhausted, I joined an operation I knew nothing about
It was a mysterious mission: allies attacking an allied base
That cursed war that warped my fate ended that day. But it meant nothing...
From the moment I saw it, my own endless battle had begun...
But not as strong as Chirico is now...
But not as strong as Proto One is now...
But not as strong as Kan Yu is now...
But not as strong as Potalia is now...
But not as strong as Kiderer is now...
But not as strong as Shakko is now...
But not as strong as Zophie is now...
But not as strong as Grego is now...
But not as strong as Mousa is now...
But not as strong as Baiman is now...
But not as strong as Niva is now...
But not as strong as Teitania is now...
But not as strong as he is now...
Pushing Chirico this far is quite something.
Pushing Proto One this far is quite something.
Pushing Kan Yu this far is quite something.
